subject: RADD
title: TCP Radiology
description: This one-week course will introduce students to imaging of the common and important conditions of the chest, abdomen, musculoskeletal and neurological systems as well as pediatric-related pathologies. Through small group session and clinical apprenticeship sessions with technologists, residents and radiologists, students better understand how medical images are acquired in each modality and how they are interpreted by the radiologist.

restrictions.text: Open only to students in the M.D., C.M. program.
